crossRefs.note: My soul is among lions. I lie among those who are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows…
There is one who speaks rashly like the piercing of a sword, but the tongue of the wise heals.
There is a generation whose teeth are like swords, and their jaws like knives, to devour the poor from the earth, and…
No weapon that is formed against you will prevail; and you will condemn every tongue that rises against you in…
“They bend their tongue, as their bow, for falsehood. They have grown strong in the land, but not for truth; for they…
And the tongue is a fire. The world of iniquity among our members is the tongue, which defiles the whole body, and sets…
For, behold, the wicked bend their bows. They set their arrows on the strings, that they may shoot in darkness at the…
Let them vanish like water that flows away. When they draw the bow, let their arrows be made blunt.
